links.outcome: Concordance of LLM treatment recommendations with real-world physician decisions in HCC registry
links.effect: Concordance rates were 31.1% (ChatGPT 4o), 32.7% (Gemini 2.0), and 26.8% (Claude 3.5); concordance in BCLC-C associated with worse survival (ChatGPT 4o HR 1.650).
links.quote: Concordance rates between LLM recommendations and physician decisions were 31.1% (ChatGPT 4o), 32.7% (Gemini 2.0), and 26.8% (Claude 3.5).

links.outcome: Survival of patients whose treatment matched LLM recommendations versus mismatched, by BCLC stage
links.effect: BCLC-A concordance improved survival (ChatGPT 4o HR 0.743); BCLC-C concordance worse survival (HR 1.650, Gemini 1.586, Claude 1.483); BCLC-B modest or nonsignificant.
links.quote: In BCLC-A patients, treatment concordance with LLM recommendations was associated with significantly improved survival (ChatGPT 4o HR: 0.743, 95% CI [0.665, 0.831], P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM treatment recommendations against real-world physician decisions and patient survival in a large hepatocellular carcinoma registry without evaluating a deployment guardrail or practice.
